MoAI-ADK 2026.11.0-rc.1 — agentic development kit

Usage: moai <command> [options]
       moai cc|codex|glm -l|-a    lead or agent session

Start
  cc                      Start a Claude Code session
  codex                   Start a Codex CLI session
  glm                     Start a Claude Code session on
                          z.ai GLM
Project
  project-detect          Detect the project's facts
  project-plan            Preview the project profile
  project-apply           Write a previewed project profile
  language-setup          Choose the writing language item
                          by item
  index-build             Build the code map index
  agents-plan
  agents-apply
  generation-plan         Plan project-specific generated
                          files read-only (03-C #1997):
                          typed request on stdin; judgment
                          envelope on stdout; writes nothing
  generation-apply        Apply an approved generation plan
                          (03-C #1997): the exact plan on
                          stdin, `--plan-digest` and
                          `--permission-reference`
  github-plan             Plan the GitHub templates of a
                          project (08-B #2013): typed
                          request on stdin (`github_issues`
                          opts in); read-only
  github-apply            Apply an approved GitHub template
                          plan (08-B #2013): the exact plan
                          on stdin, `--plan-digest` and
                          `--permission-reference`
  labels-plan             Plan a project's label sync from
                          `.github/moai/labels.yml` (#2434
                          decision 40): typed request
                          `{schema_version, owner, repo}` on
                          stdin; GET only, never deletes
  labels-apply            Apply an approved label sync plan
                          (#2434 decision 40): the exact
                          plan on stdin, `--plan-digest` and
                          `--permission-reference`;
                          POST/PATCH only
  claude-settings-plan    Preview a three-way merge of the
                          managed keys (`outputStyle`,
                          `statusLine`, `permissions`) on
                          stdin into
                          PROJECT/.claude/settings.json
                          (#2239); other keys are refused.
                          Writes nothing
  claude-settings-apply   Apply a previewed settings merge:
                          same stdin, the preview's digest
                          and a permission reference. Writes
                          the project settings file and its
                          receipt only; home is refused
  codex-config-plan       Preview managed dotted keys from
                          stdin in
                          PROJECT/.codex/config.toml; never
                          writes
  codex-config-apply      Apply a previewed project config
                          with the same stdin, digest and
                          permission reference. User HOME
                          and CODEX_HOME config targets are
                          refused; trust is never changed
  hooks-plan              Preview the MoAI hook set for one
                          host in PROJECT (rc.2 I1 #2238);
                          writes nothing
  hooks-apply             Write a previewed hook set and its
                          receipt; requires the plan digest
Update and move
  update                  Update MoAI from the installed
                          package
  go-state-plan           Preview moving the Go-era .moai
                          folder
  go-state-apply          Move a previewed Go-era .moai
                          folder
  go-state-revert-plan    Preview undoing a Go-era folder
                          move
  go-state-revert         Undo a Go-era folder move
  home-state-plan         Preview moving the Go-era ~/.moai
                          folder
  home-state-apply        Move a previewed Go-era ~/.moai
                          folder
  home-state-revert       Undo a ~/.moai folder move
  worktree-move-plan      Preview moving this clone's
                          worktrees
  worktree-move-apply     Move the previewed worktrees
  update-plan             Read-only UPDATE preview over
                          every host projection (04-B #1999;
                          the command name is P06 HOLD).
                          HOME is the user home root; STAGE
                          is the package directory to apply
  update-apply            Apply a previewed UPDATE host by
                          host (04-B #1999;
                          pending→committed receipts). The
                          previewed plan travels on stdin
                          and must match a fresh recompute
  recovery-plan           Read-only recovery plan for UPDATE
                          hosts left `pending` (04-C #2000;
                          names P06 HOLD)
  recovery-apply          Revert only this request's changes
                          on pending hosts (04-C #2000). The
                          previewed plan travels on stdin
                          and must match a fresh recompute
  apply-recover           Revert exactly the files one apply
                          request published, from its
                          receipt (Issue #1989, 01-B). Files
                          changed since the apply are
                          skipped, never overwritten
  layout-plan             P09 opt-in home layout (#2175):
                          measure the receipt/outbox/claim
                          stores and bind a move plan to
                          `~/.moai-cli/projects/<project_id>/`.
                          Writes nothing
  layout-apply            Execute a confirmed layout plan:
                          copy without deleting the
                          originals, verify the copy, then
                          switch the pointer
                          (`layout.json`). The default stays
                          project-side
  migrate-plan            Go MoAI migration preview (#2016)
                          on a prepared synthetic HOME only:
                          typed request on stdin (`hosts`,
                          `mode`, `go_release`,
                          `selections`); shows ownership,
                          the update-conflict preview and
                          the plan digest. Writes nothing
  migrate-apply           Apply a previewed migration
                          (#2016): the exact plan on stdin
                          must equal a fresh recompute and
                          `--plan-digest`. Backs up, then
                          copies only the selected owned
                          files to `.moai-cli/imports/`; the
                          Go source is kept
  migrate-recovery-plan   Read-only recovery plan for one
                          migration apply (#2016), from its
                          backup manifest
  migrate-recover         Remove only the imports one
                          migration apply published (#2016);
                          changed files are kept. The
                          recovery plan travels on stdin and
                          must match a fresh recompute
  skills-legacy           List legacy `moai-*` skill folders
                          (every `moai-` entry except `moai`
                          itself) under the user skill
                          folders of the supported hosts in
                          HOME (the list is
                          `skills_legacy::ROOTS`), with
                          `count` and a `summary` line that
                          says `0건` when there are none,
                          plus the Codex `[[skills.config]]`
                          entry that turns each Codex-read
                          one off. Links are reported, never
                          followed (a folder on the way, an
                          entry or its `SKILL.md`); a
                          `SKILL.md` is read only when it is
                          a regular file of at most 64 KiB,
                          so a FIFO never blocks the check.
                          Reads only; moves, deletes and
                          edits nothing
  bin-names-plan          Preview the two command names
                          (#2791 AC-1): in the version
                          folder this binary runs from,
                          `~/.moai-cli/versions/<version>/bin/`,
                          `moai` should be a hard link to
                          `moai-cli`. Says `create`,
                          `unchanged`, `replace_copy` (a
                          separate copy of this same build
                          is moved aside), `blocked` (a
                          link, a folder or another program
                          named `moai`) or `outside_layout`.
                          Writes nothing; PATH and shell
                          files are never touched
  bin-names-apply         Make the `moai` hard link
                          `bin-names-plan` previewed (#2791
                          AC-1). The digest must match a
                          fresh preview; only `create` and
                          `replace_copy` write. A separate
                          copy is moved aside to
                          `moai.replaced-<UTC>`, never
                          deleted, and moved back if the
                          link fails
  agents-home-plan        Preview installing the base MoAI
                          agents into HOME's host agent
                          folders (#2592): per file create,
                          update, unchanged, preserved (your
                          edit), conflict or remove_blocked.
                          Writes nothing
  agents-home-apply       Apply a previewed base agent
                          install (#2592): only create and
                          update are written, with a receipt
                          holding the before bytes. The
                          digest must match a fresh preview
  agents-home-revert      Undo one base agent install
                          (#2592) for the files that still
                          hold the bytes it wrote: a created
                          file is removed, an updated one
                          gets its before bytes back; a
                          changed file is skipped
  home-routing-plan       Preview the MoAI routing section
                          in HOME's global instruction files
                          (#2638): per host create, append,
                          merge, unchanged or conflict, and
                          the hosts not written with the
                          reason. Writes nothing
  home-routing-apply      Apply a previewed MoAI routing
                          section (#2638): only the managed
                          block changes, with a receipt
                          holding the before bytes. The
                          digest must match a fresh preview
  home-routing-revert     Undo one routing section apply
                          (#2638) for the files that still
                          hold the bytes it wrote; a file
                          changed since is skipped and
                          reported
Keys
  key-set                 Store a provider key in the vault
  key-status              Check a provider key without
                          showing it
  key-remove              Remove a provider key from the
                          vault
  key-import-plan         Preview importing an old key file
  key-import-apply        Import a previewed old key file
Diagnose
  claude-doctor           Check that Claude Code reads
                          AGENTS.md
  codex-doctor            Check the Codex instructions and
                          skills
  install-inspect         Show the installed MoAI binaries
  identity                Show where a path sits in its
                          clone
  worktree-report         Report the space worktrees use
  optimize-plan           Preview space that can be freed
  baseline-inventory      List a checkout's baseline facts
Lane and leader
  claim-acquire           Claim a task (06-A #2005): typed
                          JSON request on stdin; posts
                          exactly one claim comment (⑤)
                          behind the same-host journal
                          serialization (①) and records the
                          record
  claim-verify            Re-verify claim ownership before a
                          commit or push (rc.2 A9 #2255);
                          GET only. Typed request on stdin,
                          or `--hook` with a host PreToolUse
                          input (refusal exits 2)
  claim-show              Read the current claim record of a
                          task key; byte-identical when
                          repeated
  claim-release           Close the active claim as
                          `cancelled`; the epoch must match
                          the current record
  claim-handoff           Explicit leader handoff (06-B
                          #2006): liveness probe, worktree
                          evidence, close as `handed_off`;
                          an alive or indeterminate owner
                          needs --force-explicit
  queue-next              Self-claim the next card (rc.2 A2
                          #2161): typed JSON request on
                          stdin; re-reads the open Issues,
                          skips epics, pull requests and
                          open-blocked cards, and claims the
                          first candidate through
                          `claim-acquire` under one journal
                          lock
  queue-free              List the open cards a lane may
                          take (#2675): typed JSON
                          `{schema_version, owner, repo}` on
                          stdin; GET only. Every open Issue
                          lands in one bucket (free,
                          reserved, claimed, held, epics,
                          blocked); an empty result says
                          `free_count: 0`
  queue-query             Read the merge train in a pinned
                          leader Issue comment; GET only, no
                          local store
  leader-tick             Leader supervision tick (rc.2 A3
                          #2162): typed JSON request on
                          stdin; GET-only read of open PRs,
                          reports only what changed since
                          the last tick, drafts assignee
                          hints
  lane-status             Lane status table (rc.2 A11
                          #2265): typed JSON request on
                          stdin; GET-only read of the named
                          Issues, their open PRs and the
                          local worktrees; writes nothing
  lane-handoff-check      Lane handoff gate (rc.2 A10
                          #2264): typed JSON request on
                          stdin; read-only verification that
                          the worktree is safe to exit —
                          status clean, HEAD == observed
                          remote == PR head, claim trailers
                          on lane-authored non-merge
                          commits, leader report record
                          present, no publish_unknown outbox
                          effects. A failed status blocks
                          the exit (kind blocked, exit 1)
                          with a preservation note
  lane-safe-to-reset      Before a lane's session is cleared
                          or its card dispatched elsewhere
                          (#2669): map the lane to its
                          worktrees, count their
                          uncommitted, unpushed and stashed
                          work, and check the caller's
                          observations of the lane's open
                          claims (each with a resume note),
                          session folder and screen
                          (background jobs). `safe` only
                          when every check ran clean; any
                          finding is `not_safe`; a check
                          that could not run is `unknown`
                          with its reason. Reads only
  session-register        Register this session's lane name
                          in the clone's registry (`<clone
                          common dir>/
                          .moai-cli/sessions/<name>.json`)
                          before claiming (#2592 S-C). A
                          name another instance holds under
                          a live lease is refused
                          (`conflict`); the first call
                          returns a fresh `instance`, and
                          later calls with `--instance`
                          renew the lease. `--release` frees
                          the name before the session is
                          cleared
  usage-limit             Read
                          `<HOME>/.moai-cli/state/usage-limits.json`,
                          which the Claude Code status line
                          writes on each render, and report
                          `ok`, `near` (a window at 90% or
                          more), `reached` or `unknown`,
                          with `renew_until` (reset + 15
                          minutes) for near and reached.
                          Writes nothing
  heavy-slot-acquire      Wait for one of N machine-wide
                          heavy-run slots, run COMMAND
                          holding it, and exit with
                          COMMAND's code (#2677). Same
                          folder and lock as
                          `tools/heavy_check_slot.py`; while
                          waiting and on failure it prints
                          the load averages and free disk
                          space. Unix only
  heavy-slot-status       List the heavy-run slots held now,
                          the slot paths refused, and the
                          machine's load and free disk space
                          (#2677). Reads only
  goal-show               Show the standing goal of this
                          clone (#2679): `state` is
                          `active`, `cleared` or `none`,
                          with the stored text, end
                          condition, exclusions, source,
                          start time and revision. The
                          leader and every lane read it at
                          the start of a round. Reads only
  goal-plan               Preview a change of the standing
                          goal (#2679): `change` is
                          `create`, `update`, `clear`,
                          `unchanged` or `none`, with the
                          changed fields and the
                          `plan_digest` that `goal-apply`
                          needs. `asks_person` is true only
                          when something would change.
                          Writes nothing
  goal-apply              Write a previewed change of the
                          standing goal (#2679), only with
                          the `plan_digest` of a fresh
                          `goal-plan` for the same request
                          and the same file. An `unchanged`
                          or `none` plan writes nothing
  goal-block              Build the `/goal` paste block from
                          the state on stdin (#2163; #2708
                          moved it from
                          tools/gen_goal_block.py):
                          `{milestone, issues, prs,
                          keep_set}` in, the leader line,
                          the agent's lane-wide loop line
                          and card lines, and the Codex line
                          out. Reads only stdin
  gate-check              The leader merge gate (#2674),
                          read-only: decides whether every
                          rule G1–G11 holds for one pull
                          request (G8: the tip's last
                          completed push CI is not red, or
                          this PR is its repair, #2777; G9:
                          the auditor is not an author; G10:
                          every PR commit but a merge has a
                          `Moai-Claim` trailer; G11: the PR
                          body has a `Moai-Claim: ` line)
                          and prints `pass`, or the rule
                          that stopped and why. With `--pr`
                          it reads the pull request from
                          GitHub (GET only) and the local
                          repository (the head and tip must
                          already be fetched); without it,
                          it decides from a snapshot on
                          stdin. Posts nothing, merges
                          nothing
  gate-merge              Merge one pull request only when
                          the leader merge gate passes
                          (#2674 S2): checks every rule
                          G1–G11 like `gate-check --pr`,
                          then posts the `moai/audit`
                          success status on the head, merges
                          with the head pinned (at most
                          three attempts) and posts the
                          merge record. A stopped gate
                          writes nothing. Needs a permission
                          reference
  gate-loop               One pass of the leader's merge
                          loop (#2674 S4): runs `gate-merge`
                          on every open, non-draft pull
                          request into the integration
                          branch, and once per head updates
                          the branch on a code overlap with
                          the tip (G6) or asks the claim
                          holder when the verdict's author
                          holds no allowed claim (G2). The
                          leader or a scheduler calls it
                          instead of a shell loop. Needs a
                          permission reference; the heads
                          must already be fetched (a missing
                          one is skipped)
  wait                    Wait until a condition holds on
                          GitHub, then end. KIND is `ci`
                          (every workflow run of `--head`
                          completed), `comment` (a comment
                          on `--issue` newer than `--after`,
                          optionally with a line starting
                          `--prefix`) or `pr` (pull request
                          `--pr` no longer at `--head`, or
                          closed). Polls are conditional
                          requests (an unchanged answer is a
                          304), one at a time, at least
                          `--interval` and GitHub's
                          `x-poll-interval` apart. A timeout
                          answers `matched: false`
  scope-check             write_scope overlap of a claim
                          against the other active claims
                          (06-C #2007)
  worktree-plan           Plan the branch and worktree of a
                          claim (06-C #2007). Writes nothing
  worktree-apply          Create the planned worktree with
                          `git worktree add --lock -b` (06-C
                          #2007); refuses without `--force`
                          when the branch, path or task
                          already has a worktree
  pr-body-render          Render the PR body of a claim
                          (06-C #2007): Refs, exact SHAs,
                          receipts, op marker
  pr-confirm              Record the PR's ACK (06-C #2007,
                          REQ-06C-11): confirm the
                          `pr_create` intent and, once it is
                          confirmed, move the claim record
                          to `pr_ready`
  audit-claim             Reserve the independent audit of
                          one exact PR head (rc.2 #2403 item
                          1): typed JSON `{schema_version,
                          owner, repo, pr, head, lane}` on
                          stdin. Reads the PR, its commits
                          and comments (GET); refuses a
                          stale head or an author lane;
                          posts at most one
                          `moai-audit-claim` comment, then
                          re-reads. The lowest reservation
                          id on the head wins (user decision
                          #2403 c6784520362). Start the
                          audit only when `outcome` is
                          `reserved`
  audit-clone-plan        Read-only plan of an independent
                          audit clone (WT-3, #2380): the
                          single-branch, no-checkout clone
                          commands for an exact PR head and
                          where the evidence is kept. Runs
                          nothing, no network
  labels-check            Report the open Issues whose
                          labels break the axis rule of the
                          project's
                          `.github/moai/labels.yml` (exactly
                          one `type:*`, exactly one
                          `priority:*`, one or two `area:*`,
                          no `not_used` or unlisted label).
                          Reads GitHub with GET only and
                          never adds or removes a label
  decision-due            Sort the unanswered decisions of
                          one bundle at `--now` (default:
                          the clock): still open, default
                          applies (reversible, category
                          `none`, the user's, past its
                          deadline), or on hold (one-way,
                          `guarded` or a HOLD category, past
                          its deadline). Reads only; applies
                          nothing
  decision-file-check     Check one decision bundle under
                          `docs/decisions/` (#2619): the
                          table, every field, and that a
                          one-way, `guarded` or
                          HOLD-category decision is the
                          user's. Reads only
  decision-append         Add rows (stdin) after the last
                          row of the user-decisions log's
                          single table (#2403). The log must
                          equal HEAD in the worktree and
                          index, and HEAD the given base;
                          existing rows are never edited or
                          removed. Preview by default;
                          `--apply` writes. Rows go to the
                          end of the table, so read the log
                          by its time column, not by row
                          order. The remote is not checked
                          (`remote_checked: false`): fetch
                          the tip first and pass it as
                          `base`
  flow-wip-check          Flow control (A13 #2279): WIP cap
                          check over the open pull requests
                          of the repository — the
                          assignment-refusal signal (the
                          refusal itself is the leader's
                          act). GET-only
  dispatch-record         Record a dispatch revision over
                          durable S1 messages (typed JSON
                          stdin)
  dispatch-ack            Record received ACK and explicit
                          accepted/deferred/rejected
                          decision, separately
  dispatch-check          Observe dispatch revisions,
                          decisions and the five-minute ACK
                          alert (GET only). Never authorizes
                          a claim or an audit gate
  message-record          Publish a durable message from
                          typed JSON on stdin; queued is not
                          receiver ACK or business
                          acceptance
  message-ack             Publish an explicit receiver ACK
                          from typed JSON on stdin; not
                          business acceptance or completion
  message-reconcile       Reconcile messages from typed JSON
                          on stdin: remote GET only, with
                          local reconciliation writes; never
                          publishes messages or ACKs
  effect-intend           Record an external-write intent
                          before it is sent (REQ-06B-06);
                          payload JSON on stdin gives the
                          intent digest. A stale epoch is
                          fenced (REQ-06B-08)
  effect-confirm          Confirm an intended effect after
                          the write returned, or mark it
                          uncertain
  effects-reconcile       Reconcile uncertain effects
                          against the remote by their stable
                          marker (GET only, never
                          re-creates). `--remote-probe`
                          replaces the built-in comment
                          lookup (tests)
Checks
  review-package          The deterministic review package
                          for an AUDIT (#2614): the diff
                          from the merge base to HEAD, the
                          changed files, and the review
                          instructions (`REVIEW.md` and its
                          includes) and context
                          (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) read
                          from BASE only. Reads git; writes
                          nothing
  review-check            Format check of review findings
                          before they are posted (#2614
                          AC-3): stdin
                          `{"schema_version":1,"findings":[…]}`;
                          each finding needs a severity, a
                          `file:line` in HEAD, a title,
                          evidence quoted from that line,
                          and a confirmed verification.
                          Prints the verdict (any
                          `important` is FAIL), counts, post
                          body and digest. Reads git only
  repo-scans              List the repo-wide scan tests a
                          merge must run first (#2681; #2708
                          moved it from
                          tools/repo_scans.py). With `--refs
                          <tip> <head>` the change sets are
                          `git diff --name-only` from their
                          merge-base and the table is the
                          union of `tools/repo_scans.json`
                          at both refs; without it, stdin
                          `{"pr": [...], "tip": [...]}` is
                          judged with the fallback table.
                          The result is `{remerge, hits,
                          checks, reasons}`; any internal
                          error fails safe to `remerge:
                          true` with every check, and no
                          readable table means hold the
                          merge. Reads only
  pr-self-audit-check     Check a PR body's Self-Audit
                          section (#2708, formerly
                          tools/check_pr_self_audit.py): the
                          body from --file or stdin; prints
                          one line, `self-audit: pass (…)`
                          (exit 0) or `self-audit: blocked
                          missing=…` (exit 1); a usage error
                          exits 2. Raw text, not the
                          envelope, so the result and exit
                          code are the ones the Python
                          checker gave
  flake-classify          Classify flaky tests (#2666):
                          given the log of a failed CI run
                          and the log of a later run of the
                          same head (`gh run view <id>
                          --log` saved to a file), list the
                          tests that failed first and passed
                          later (flaky), failed in both
                          (still failing), or are absent
                          from the later log. Reads the two
                          files only; writes nothing
  flake-record            Record flaky tests (#2666): for
                          every flaky row of a
                          `flake-classify` result, comment
                          on the open Issue that tracks the
                          test (hidden marker on its first
                          line), or create `[flake] <test>`
                          when none is open. A run and job
                          already recorded writes nothing.
                          Needs a permission reference
  audit-delta             Compare one local two-parent merge
                          with a controlled replay; evidence
                          only, not AUDIT PASS
  audit-reduce            Temporary (05-D #2004; the name is
                          fixed after P06): independent
                          audit of PROJECT. Re-runs the
                          approved verification itself and
                          decides admission; receipts on
                          stdin never count
  parity-check            Semantic parity of TEMPLATE vs
                          GENERATED (optional third DOC set,
                          D6 #2192): per-key classification
                          with the 00-A vocabulary (missing
                          / extra / value_mismatch /
                          identical / doc_only). Read-only
  plan-admit              Temporary (05-B #2002; the name is
                          fixed after P06): RUN admission of
                          an approved plan. Typed request on
                          stdin; reads the project's
                          `HEAD^{commit}` with git, writes
                          nothing
  run-verify              Temporary (05-C #2003; the name is
                          fixed after P06): re-check the
                          pinned contract and run the
                          approved verification commands in
                          PROJECT as argv; returns a receipt
Internal
  statusline              Render the Claude Code status line
                          from the session JSON on stdin
                          (#2350). The one operation that
                          prints raw text instead of the
                          JSON envelope: Claude Code shows
                          the command's stdout as is. Always
                          exits 0
  hook-receipt            Hook handler: record one
                          allow-listed receipt line from the
                          host's hook stdin under
                          ./.moai-cli/receipts/; never fails
                          the hook
  hook-dispatch           Hook engine (#2391): run one MoAI
                          hook duty for a host and print the
                          host's native answer; reads the
                          host's hook JSON on stdin, no
                          network
  forge-read              Read GitHub Issues and comments as
                          TODO (GET only; typed JSON request
                          on stdin, envelope on stdout).
                          Poll state:
                          `<PROJECT>/.moai-cli/forge/poll-state.json`
  forge-links-probe       Probe whether the sub-issue and
                          dependency APIs answer for one
                          Issue and plan the links: API
                          write intents, or
                          `Parent:`/`Blocked-By:` body lines
                          (GET only; #2172)
  forge-report            Create or update the one report
                          comment of a run on its Issue
                          (typed JSON payload on stdin;
                          envelope on stdout). Large output
                          goes to artifact references, not
                          the body
  forge-audit-status      Post the `moai/audit` commit
                          status on an exact SHA (typed JSON
                          on stdin). Uses the audit App
                          token from `MOAI_AUDIT_APP_TOKEN`
                          when set, else warns (#2173)
  index-query             Query the incremental index (C6
                          #2182): read-only — resolves the
                          published generation and reports
                          one of
                          fresh/stale/partial/unavailable
                          with the detected changes
                          (additions, deletions,
                          modifications, untracked new
                          files, branch switch)
  atlas-map               Code Map query (C9 #2185):
                          read-only — the published
                          generation's map records (file and
                          tag nodes, `annotated_by` edges,
                          missing coverage) of the requested
                          paths or directory prefixes;
                          `unavailable` when no index
                          records can be read
  atlas-graph             Code Graph query (C9 #2185):
                          read-only — a bounded-hop walk
                          over the same generation's map and
                          graph records from the given node
                          ids; `unavailable` when no index
                          records can be read
  atlas-tag-scan          Read-only dual-read scan of
                          `@MOAI:` / `@MX:` tag markers (C2
                          #2178): both namespaces normalize
                          into one node shape, duplicates
                          are diagnosed only, nothing is
                          written. PATH is a file or a
                          directory
  search                  Non-vector-first search (C7
                          #2183): read-only — exact paths
                          first, then literal matches over
                          the published index generation (or
                          the tracked files), each result
                          with a source citation; the
                          typed-edge step is reported
                          unavailable (#2408)
  context-bundle          Read-only: requested file ranges
                          with digests and a budget (typed
                          request on stdin)
  context-verify          Read-only: re-check a bundle's
                          ranges against the files now
                          (typed request on stdin)
  decision-record         Append one native decision record
                          (stdin) to
                          `.moai-cli/decisions/<RUN>.jsonl`
  cost-report             Aggregate cost items across
                          run/verify receipts (D5 #2191):
                          typed request (receipt array) on
                          stdin; breakdown envelope on
                          stdout; writes nothing. External
                          backend calls are structurally
                          zero; tokens are absent, never
                          estimated (REQ-D5-01)
  snapshot-describe       Read-only: PROJECT's HEAD commit
                          and a digest of its tracked
                          changes (07-D #2011)
  package-inspect
  package-resolve
  codex-projection-plan   Plan a Codex projection of the
                          common package into an explicit
                          target; writes nothing
  codex-projection-apply  Install a planned Codex projection
                          into its explicit target (I4
                          #2241). Refuses a stale plan, a
                          source-manifest mismatch or a
                          conflicting target file before
                          writing
  project-skill-plan      Plan project-unit `moai` skill
                          copies read-only (I5 #2242, P04
                          HOLD): typed request on stdin;
                          judgment envelope on stdout;
                          writes nothing
  project-skill-apply     Copy the staged `moai` skill
                          package into the project host
                          folders (I5 #2242): the exact
                          request on stdin; requires
                          `opt_in` and writes only under the
                          caller-supplied project root
  project-skill-revert    Revert one applied project-skill
                          copy from its rollback receipt (I5
                          #2242): typed request on stdin
  archive-plan            Dry-run (D1 #2187, REQ-D1-01):
                          which SPEC directories under
                          `.moai-cli/specs/` are
                          archive-eligible and why the rest
                          are excluded. Writes nothing.
                          `--grace-days` overrides the
                          profile's inactivity window
  archive-apply           Move the archive-eligible SPECs
                          (D2 #2188, REQ-D2-01): recomputes
                          the plan and requires its
                          `plan_digest`; each SPEC is
                          hashed, copied, read back and
                          indexed before its source is
                          removed. Any mismatch cancels the
                          move and keeps the source
  archive-restore         Restore one archived SPEC to
                          `.moai-cli/specs/<id>` after
                          verifying its manifest (D2 #2188)
  archive-search          Read-only, non-vector search over
                          the archive index and archived
                          text (D2 #2188)
  worktree-gc-plan        Read-only removal plan (WT-4,
                          #2380): per linked worktree
                          `remove`, `trim` (cargo build
                          output only) or `skip` with
                          reasons, and a digest. Deletes
                          nothing
  worktree-gc-apply       Act on a `worktree-gc-plan` (WT-9,
                          #2498): recomputes the plan with
                          the same inputs, refuses before
                          any write unless its digest equals
                          `--plan-digest`, then trims the
                          listed cargo output and removes
                          the listed worktrees (no
                          `--force`; branches kept)
  session                 Legacy Claude-only launcher kept
                          for compatibility; prefer `-l|-a`
                          or `cc|glm|codex`

Options:
  -l, --leader
          Start a leader session on the default host (cc)
  -a, --agent [<HOST>]
          Start an agent session on HOST (cc|glm|codex;
          default cc)
      --name <NAME>
          Session name (default `leader` for -l, the
          project's next `agent-N` for -a; none without a
          role)
      --model <MODEL>
          Main model (Claude hosts default `opus`; codex
          uses its own default unless set)
      --effort <EFFORT>
          Claude effort (default `medium`)
      --advisor <ADVISOR>
          Advisor model on Claude hosts (fable|opus|sonnet
          or a full claude-* id). None by default; the user
          setting `launcher.advisor` can turn it on. May
          bill to usage credits
      --no-advisor
          Pass no `--advisor` even when the user setting
          `launcher.advisor` turns it on
      --permissions
          Keep permission prompts: no
          `--dangerously-skip-permissions` (Claude hosts)
          and the `workspace-write` / `on-request` sandbox
          on codex. Without it a -l|-a session has full
          access; a session without a role never gets a
          permission flag
      --dry-run
          Print the composed command as JSON instead of
          starting the host
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version

Run 'moai <command> --help' for details and examples.
